events.name: 2026 Suhandinata Cup
events.coverage: India's and Singapore's mixed-team results in the Suhandinata Cup (the World Junior Championships team event). The event uses a subgroup round robin, then a group play-off to settle 1st-8th in each of 8 groups, then a knockout ranking stage for the rest (5-10 October). India finished 13th and Singapore finished 27th. Individual rubber scores are not published on the source page for the group-stage ties, only each tie's overall 2-set or 3-set result, so rubbers are omitted; the classification stage's ties are not recorded as separate matches here (see notes).

sources.label: 2026 BWF World Junior Championships/9th to 16th classification (Wikipedia template)

events.notes: India finished 2nd of 8 teams in Group D (won subgroup D1 over Algeria and Peru, then lost the group play-off to UAE); Singapore finished 4th of 6 teams in Group B (2nd in subgroup B1, then lost the group's second-placed play-off to Canada). In the 9th-16th classification bracket, India lost its first tie 1-2 to Chinese Taipei, beat the Czech Republic 2-0 in the 13th-16th play-off, then beat England 2-0 in the 13th-14th place match to finish 13th. In the 25th-32nd classification bracket, Singapore beat Poland 2-1, lost to Sri Lanka 0-2, then beat Finland 2-0 in the 27th-28th place match to finish 27th (confirmed by the final ranking table). The classification bracket's individual ties are not recorded as separate results here: the schema's badminton team round vocabulary (G1-G3 plus QF/SF/F/3P) has no code for a team that loses and keeps playing outside the semi-final-to-bronze case, so recording them as QF/SF/F would wrongly end a continuing team's run under the knockout-loss check. No dates are published for the classification ties. Individual rubber scores are not published on the source page for the group-stage ties, only each tie's overall 2-set or 3-set result, so rubbers are omitted.
